name: Wylde_Study
description: Browser-side study assistant — index pages into the Wylde memory graph, answer questions over the indexed corpus via RAG, and summarize / explain / generate flashcards via the configured LLM. Served by the native Rust binary wylde-ext-study (greenfield port, PR #3); the Python handler.py shim is retired. The MV3 browser_extension/ is untouched and still talks back over Gateway /extensions/Wylde_Study/<endpoint>.

resources.description: A study corpus entry: an indexed web page (URL + title + extracted text) stored as an episodic memory, searchable by question, and the source material for LLM-generated summaries / explanations / flashcards. CRUD-shaped, but only create + search + execute are backed by a tool today (see omitted ops below).

create.description: Index a web page (title + URL + extracted text) into the Wylde memory graph as an episodic study note. Writes a persistent memory row tagged with the source URL.

session_id.description: Session id grouping pages indexed together

search.description: Answer a question against the indexed corpus via RAG. Returns the top-k matching chunks for the LLM (or extension UI) to ground on.

execute.description: Run an LLM transformation over supplied study material. The 'action' selects summarize | explain | flashcards. Read-only: no corpus is written.

actions.name: summarize
actions.description: Summarize the supplied text via the configured LLM. Returns a short structured summary + key points.

actions.name: explain
actions.description: Explain a concept or excerpt in plain language for a target audience via the LLM.

actions.name: flashcards
actions.description: Generate Q/A flashcards from the supplied text via the LLM. Returns a list of {front, back} objects.
